test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year were the islands of Laccadive, Minicoy, and Amindivi changed into Union Territory of Lakshadweep by an Act of Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1973.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Islands of Laccadive, Minicoy, and Amindivi changed into **Union Territory of Lakshadweep by an Act 1973 of Parliament.**
 
• Lakshadweep is the smallest Union Territory of India.
 
• The old name of Lakshadweep was Laccadive.
 
• Lakshadweep got the official name on 1st November 1973.
 
 
• Capital - Kavaratti
 
• Lieutenant Governor - Praful Patel(Sept 2022)
 
 
 
• The former capital of Lakshadweep is Kozhikode and the capital was shifted to Kavaratti in 1964.
 
• Lakshadweep is the most Literate Union Territory.
 
• Lakshadweep comes under the jurisdiction of the Kerala High Court.
